rustySword.description: A well-worn sword with patches of rust along the blade. Looks barely functional.
rustySword.effect: Low damage weapon, better than nothing.

healingPotion.description: A small vial filled with a glowing, red liquid.
healingPotion.effect: Restores a moderate amount of health instantly.

glowingMushroom.description: A fungus that emits a soft, ethereal light.
glowingMushroom.effect: Provides temporary light in dark areas. May cause slight hallucinations.

silverKey.description: A delicate key made of polished silver.
silverKey.effect: Can unlock a specific door or chest.

climbingGear.description: A set of durable ropes and sturdy metal picks.
climbingGear.effect: Allows safe traversal of steep terrain and cliffs.

ironOre.effect: Can be smelted into useful tools or sold for coin.

darkCrystal.description: A jagged shard of black, cold crystal that seems to absorb light.
darkCrystal.effect: A powerful component for dark magic or a valuable treasure.

ancientScroll.description: A brittle, yellowed parchment tied with a ribbon. The writing is in an unknown language.
ancientScroll.effect: Contains a powerful spell or forgotten knowledge.

lantern.description: A sturdy, oil-filled lamp with glass panes and a metal frame.
lantern.effect: Provides bright, sustained light, negating darkness penalties in locations like the **enchantedForest** or **obsidianTower**.
